title: Re-timed word times for a stored Sofer transcript (source file, not published)
description: data/retimed/<encoded lecture id>.json, written by data/retime (forced alignment of the transcript's words to the audio). `words` has one entry per entry of the transcript's result.timestamps, in order. The data build also checks the word count, that starts never decrease and that `transcriptSha` matches the transcript (see data/retime/README.md for how it is computed). yarn align and the published transcripts use these times instead of Sofer's.

transcript.description: Path of the stored transcript, relative to data/.

transcriptSha.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the transcript's words and Sofer times: for each entry w of result.timestamps, w.word + TAB + ms(w.start) + TAB + ms(w.end) + LF, ms(x) = floor(x * 1000 + 0.5) as a base-10 integer, UTF-8.

method.description: Model, thresholds and transliteration that produced the times.

stats.description: Anchor coverage and spacing, for people.

words.description: Per transcript word: [startSeconds, endSeconds, score (mean character posterior, null when nothing was aligned), kind (2 anchor, 1 soft anchor, 0 interpolated)].
